ei.title: 3번 — 사회적 수용과 개인적 인정을 향한 인간의 모순된 욕구
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본2

fullPassage: We all desire to feel that we are 'normal,' that we fit in and are accepted by others, that we are one of the crowd. Put another way, we generally avoid being regarded as 'being difficult to deal with' or 'not being part of the crowd.' That is, we don't want to appear odd, strange, or anti-social in any way. It may be true that a few eccentrics might deliberately cultivate personal idiosyncracies in order to attract attention, but generally their ultimate goal is to be accepted (even if only by a small collection of admirers) and not regarded as complete social outcasts. However, while the yearning to be accepted and to belong is strong, we strain equally towards being recognized as individuals, and to being thought of as personally significant. Even if in only a minor sense, we wish to stand out from the crowd and not merely blend in with it. We would like our unique contributions to be acknowledged and we want our identities to be honoured as having some special significance in the world. We want to be visible and believed in. We don't want to be overlooked or ignored, as if we weren't there. It's not that we necessarily wish to be famous, or some kind of celebrity (although apparently, many of us wish to be), it's more that we want to avoid invisibility. In no matter how small a way, and to no matter how few people, we want to feel just a little bit special.

❌ ① rejected(거부되는): 인정의 반대
✅ ② recognized(인정받는): acknowledged와 동의어 ← 정답
❌ ③ hidden(숨겨진): 무관
❌ ④ delayed(지연된): 무관

questions.passage: We all desire to feel that we are 'normal,' that we fit in and are <u>accepted</u> by others, that we are one of the crowd. Put another way, we generally avoid being regarded as 'being difficult to deal with' or 'not being part of the crowd.' That is, we don't want to appear odd, strange, or anti-social in any way. It may be true that a few eccentrics might deliberately cultivate personal idiosyncracies in order to attract attention, but generally their ultimate goal is to be accepted (even if only by a small collection of admirers) and not regarded as complete social outcasts. However, while the yearning to be accepted and to belong is strong, we strain equally towards being recognized as individuals, and to being thought of as personally significant. Even if in only a minor sense, we wish to stand out from the crowd and not merely blend in with it. We would like our unique contributions to be acknowledged and we want our identities to be honoured as having some special significance in the world. We want to be visible and believed in. We don't want to be overlooked or ignored, as if we weren't there. It's not that we necessarily wish to be famous, or some kind of celebrity (although apparently, many of us wish to be), it's more that we want to avoid invisibility. In no matter how small a way, and to no matter how few people, we want to feel just a little bit special.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 accepted와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: accepted: 받아들여지는, 수용되는
det.analysis:
❌ ① famous(유명한): 유명함 축으로 반의어 아님
❌ ② honest(정직한): 성격 축으로 무관
✅ ③ rejected(거부되는): accepted(받아들여지는)의 정반대 ← 정답
❌ ④ simple(단순한): 복잡성 축으로 무관
det.tip: accepted=받아들여지는(ant: rejected). 오답 famous/honest/simple은 각기 다른 의미축

questions.passage:
(A) After sitting through the long meeting, he was finally able to <u>stand</u> up and walk around for a while.

(B) Even if in only a minor sense, we wish to <u>stand</u> out from the crowd and not merely blend in with it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 stand의 문맥적 의미가 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: stand: (A) (일어)서다 (동사) (B) stand out 두드러지다/눈에 띄다
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 서다 - (B) 서다: (B)는 out과 결합해 '두드러지다'
❌ ② (A) 두드러지다 - (B) 서다: (A)는 stand up으로 '일어서다'
❌ ③ (A) 참다 - (B) 두드러지다: (A)는 '참다'가 아니라 '일어서다'
✅ ④ (A) 서다 - (B) 두드러지다: (A) stand up=일어서다, (B) stand out=두드러지다 ← 정답

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a person who behaves in a strange or unusual way, often different from most people"

det.korean: 이상하거나 특이하게 행동하는 사람
det.analysis:
❌ ① admirer(팬·추종자): 누군가를 흠모하는 사람
✅ ② eccentric(괴짜): 이상하거나 특이하게 행동하는 사람=정의와 일치 ← 정답
❌ ③ celebrity(유명인): 널리 알려진 사람
❌ ④ outcast(배척당한 사람): 집단에서 내쳐진 사람

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: recognize → recognized: being 뒤의 수동태(과거분사) 형태
det.analysis: recognize(동사) → recognized(과거분사). 'being + 과거분사'는 '~되는'이라는 수동의 동명사 구문이므로 recognize를 recognized로 바꿔야 함.
